blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Sparse-to-dense motion completion recovers dense mesh motion from sparse vertex displacements. Residual priors trained on one geometry family frequently fail to beat parameter-free harmonic extension off-family. Moreover, cross-family training meets a scaling barrier: residual amplitude varies by more than an order of magnitude across geometry families and collapses as observations become denser. Since this scale depends on unknown target motion, it cannot be measured directly at test time. We decouple residual structure from physical scale by learning a dimensionless prior, estimating amplitude from observables and a lightweight correction fitted only on training sources. Our unified model surpasses harmonic extension across all evaluated families, including unseen cloth and legged bodies, without skeletons, registration, or cross-mesh correspondence. The same prior applies without retraining to point-tracked animal video and a robot grasping a soft body. Project page: https://su-terry.github.io/cepheid-website/
blocks.zh: Sparse-to-dense 运动完成后从稀少的顶点迁移中恢复了密集的网状运动. 在一个几何学家庭接受过培训的剩余前科人员往往无法在家庭外击败无参数口音扩展。 此外,跨家庭培训还遇到一个缩放障碍:残余振幅在几何家族之间变化幅度超过一个数量级,随着观测密度增大而崩溃. 由于这个尺度取决于未知的目标运动,因此无法在测试时直接测量. 我们从物理尺度中分解出残余结构,先学习一个无维度,从可观测物中估计振幅,以及只安装在训练来源上的轻量级校正。 我们的统一模式超越了所有被评价家庭的口音延伸,包括没有骨架、登记或交叉通信的看不见的布和腿的尸体。 同样的前作在不进行再培训的情况下适用于有指向的动物视频和抓住柔软身体的机器人. 项目网页:https://su-terry.github.io/cepheid-website/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Without skeletons, registration, or cross-mesh correspondence, sparse-to-dense motion completion infers dense mesh motion from sparse displacements under partial visibility. Mesh connectivity yields a closed-form discrete harmonic extension, solving the graph Dirichlet problem in one sparse linear solve with observed vertices as boundary conditions. We use harmonic extension as the base for the learned residual and as the parameter-free control. Predictions worse than this control reveal that completion would have been more accurate without learning.
blocks.zh: 在没有骨架、登记或交叉通信的情况下,稀有到敏感运动的完成就意味着在部分可见度下,稀有的流离失所现象会产生密集的网状运动。 网格连通产生闭式离散口口腔延伸,在一个以观测到的顶点作为边界条件的稀疏线性解析中解决了图Dirichlet问题. 我们使用口琴延伸作为学习到的剩余部分的基础,并作为无参数的控制. 比这种控制更糟糕的预测表明,不学习完成本会更准确.

blocks.en: Priors trained on one geometry family fail to transfer reliably. Across three single-family models (DT4D animals, AMASS humans, Franka arm) and a unified model, seven of twelve single-family transfers fail to improve on harmonic extension. On cloth, the AMASS and Franka priors are 25.5% and 7.8% worse than the base, respectively. Because all share a frozen amplitude rule, these are failures of the residual priors. Training jointly across families also encounters extent-normalized residual amplitudes varying by 18 – 39 × 18\text{--}39\times across the three training families at matched density and falling by more than an order of magnitude across densities. Lacking target motion at inference, the residual cannot be normalized by its own scale.
blocks.zh: 在一个几何系受过训练的先辈无法可靠地转移。 在整个三个单家庭模式(DT4D动物,AMASS人类,Franka手臂)和一个统一的模式中,12个单家庭转移中有7个无法改善口腔延伸. 在布料方面,AMASS和Franka的前科分别比底部差25.5%和7.8%. 因为所有人都有一个被冻结的振幅规则,这些是剩余前科的失败. 不同家庭之间的联合培训也遇到不同程度的常态化剩余振幅,在三个培训家庭的密度相匹配、密度相差相去甚远的幅度。 假设缺乏目标运动,剩余部分无法按自身规模正常化。

blocks.en: In Cepheid , we decouple residual structure from physical scale, learning a dimensionless residual motion prior conditioned on geometry and harmonic extension while recovering amplitude without requiring target motion (Figure Cepheid: Decoupling Scale from Structure for Cross-Family Motion Completion ). On cloth, completion error with recovered amplitude is within 1–8% of a target-informed oracle (the per-condition optimal scalar that requires ground truth). Our unified model stays below harmonic extension on all five evaluated families, cutting error by 15.6% on an unseen cloth sheet and 10.1% on unseen procedural legged bodies.
blocks.zh: 在 Cepheid 中,我们将残余结构与物理尺度脱钩,在恢复振幅而不需要目标运动的同时,先学习一个以几何和口号延伸为条件的无尺寸残余运动(Figure Cepheid:从结构中脱钩而出,用于跨家庭运动完成). 在布料上,恢复振幅的完成误差在目标知情的甲骨文(即要求地面真相的有条件的最佳平板)的1-8%以内。 我们的统一模型 在所有五个评估家庭的口琴扩展以下, 剪去15.6%的不为人知的布片错误, 和10.1%的不为人知的程序腿部。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: 1. Harmonic extension as a general base and control. We formulate motion completion around a Dirichlet solve on the mesh graph with the observed vertices as boundary conditions, providing the base for the residual and the control that seven of the twelve single-family transfers fail to improve on. 2. Target-independent amplitude recovery. We recover physical amplitude without target motion, bringing completion error on cloth within 1–8% of the error with the target-informed oracle across observation densities. 3. A shared dimensionless residual prior. We learn a dimensionless residual prior with flow matching ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023a ; Albergo & Vanden-Eijnden, 2023 ) , conditioned on geometry and the harmonic extension. We are not aware of prior work showing that a single learned prior can complete dense per-vertex motion from sparse, unlabeled vertex displacements across geometry families, without skeletons, templates, or cross-mesh correspondence, and transfer zero-shot to families absent from training. Cepheid introduces such a prior. Fine-tuning to a fixed three-marker gripper placement more than halves the error of the same checkpoint evaluated zero-shot (Appendix G ). The same checkpoint applies without retraining to point-tracked animal video and to a robot grasping a soft body.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面: 1. 声波延伸作为一般基础和控制。 我们用观测到的顶点作为边界条件,在网格图上用Dirichlet溶液进行运动完成,为剩余部分提供了基础,并控制了12个单一家庭转移中的7个未能得到改善。 2. 目标独立的振幅恢复。 我们恢复物理振幅,不进行目标运动,使布上在1%至8%的误差范围内完成出错,而整个观测密度中的目标信息甲骨文。 3. 共有的无尺寸后遗症。 我们学习出流相匹配前的无维度残基(Lipman等,2023;Liu等,2023a;Albergo和Vanden-Eijnden,2023),以几何学和口腔延伸为条件. 我们不知道以前的工作表明,一个事先学到的知识能够从几何家庭的稀少、无标签的顶点迁移中完成密集的每个顶点运动,没有骨架、模板或跨层通信,并且将零射入未接受培训的家庭。 塞菲德提出这样的前科。 精确到固定的3个标记的抓取器位置,将同一检查点评估的零发(Appendix G.)的错误减半以上。 同一个检查站在不进行再培训的情况下,适用于有指向的动物视频和抓住软体的机器人.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Harmonic extension solves the graph-Laplacian Dirichlet problem with observed vertices as boundary conditions, as in label propagation ( Zhu et al., 2003 ) . Handle-based deformation minimizes quadratic energies ( Botsch & Sorkine, 2008 ) : Laplacian editing ( Sorkine et al., 2004 ) , biharmonic deformation and weights ( Botsch & Kobbelt, 2004 ; Jacobson et al., 2011 ) , as-rigid-as-possible energies ( Sorkine & Alexa, 2007 ; Baieri et al., 2025 ) , and embedded deformation graphs ( Sumner et al., 2007 ) ; deformation transfer needs cross-mesh correspondence ( Sumner & Popović, 2004 ) . Learned handles predict cages ( Yifan et al., 2020 ) , keypoints ( Jakab et al., 2021 ) , meta-handles ( Liu et al., 2021 ) , per-face Jacobians ( Aigerman et al., 2022 ) , or local detail ( Sundararaman et al., 2024 ; Maggioli et al., 2024 ) , or follow 2D diffusion priors ( Yoo et al., 2024 ) , each trained per category. NSDP ( Tang et al., 2022 ) regresses dense motion from sparse handles per class with per-frame scale normalization; we retrain it on our split (§ 5.1 ). Per-scene optimization needs no training set ( Zhang et al., 2024b ; Song et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Bozic et al., 2021 ) ; DOMA ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) is evaluated in § 5.1 and Appendix E . Other sparse-input methods need facial landmarks on a template ( Otberdout et al., 2022 ) , labeled keypoints ( Muralikrishnan et al., 2025 ) , skeletons ( Muralikrishnan et al., 2024 ) , partial views, depth, or point clouds ( Merrouche et al., 2024 ; Maheshwari et al., 2023 ; Newcombe et al., 2015 ; Bozic et al., 2020 ; Palafox et al., 2021 ; Li & Harada, 2022 ; Han et al., 2018 ) , or images ( Collins et al., 2023 ) , or reconstruct 4D shapes without meshes ( Cao et al., 2024 ; Niemeyer et al., 2019 ; Lei & Daniilidis, 2022 ) . We instead take unlabeled displacements on a mesh, use harmonic extension as a parameter-free base and control, and learn one residual prior across families.

blocks.en: Deformable families usually come with their own representation: body models for humans and quadrupeds ( Loper et al., 2015 ; Zuffi et al., 2017 ) , the Unified Robot Description Format for robots, learned skeletal articulation for characters ( Li et al., 2021a ) , or a cloth or soft-body simulator ( Narain et al., 2012 ; Lai et al., 2026 ) . Inside one family, sparse-to-dense recovery is mature: full-body human motion is recovered from three trackers ( Dittadi et al., 2021 ; Aliakbarian et al., 2022 ; Du et al., 2023 ; Castillo et al., 2023 ; Feng et al., 2024 ; Tang et al., 2024 ) , optical markers ( Ghorbani & Black, 2021 ) , or sparse 4D input ( Marsot et al., 2022a ; Marsot et al., 2022b ) , but only through the body model. Unified models span categories with one network: UniMate ( Mou et al., 2026 ) , AnyTop ( Gat et al., 2025 ) , and OmniMotionGPT ( Yang et al., 2024 ) need an articulated motion chain, ScanMove ( Besnier et al., 2025 ) a driving motion, MeshLoom ( Chen et al., 2026b ) a complete mesh per frame, and AnimateAnyMesh ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) a text prompt. Skeleton-free transfer ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Liao et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023b ; Wang et al., 2023a ; Zhang et al., 2024a ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) needs a source pose, motion, or bone correspondence; automatic rigging ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2025a ; Chen et al., 2026a ) and trajectory control ( Liu et al., 2026 ) reintroduce a skeleton; video- or text-driven animation ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Uzolas et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2025 ; Sabathier et al., 2026 ) conditions on a prompt or a video. Closest to us, CANOR ( He et al., 2025 ) drives a mesh from learned blobs but trains per category, and CompletionAny4D ( Nishizawa et al., 2026 ) in-betweens temporally sparse but spatially complete keyframes, leaving partial regions and point trajectories to future work. Cross-embodiment robot policies ( Gupta et al., 2022 ; Bohlinger et al., 2025 ; Doshi et al., 2025 ; Sferrazza et al., 2025 ) motivate our held-out legged family. Our only signal is sparse motion observations on the target.

blocks.en: Source diversity can help transfer ( Fang et al., 2022 ) , but distribution mismatch causes negative transfer ( Albuquerque et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2019 ; Wang et al., 2023c ) ; a mesh tracker trained on six objects underperforms per-object training ( Amin Mansour et al., 2024 ) . These findings assume shared input spaces, whereas our families differ in topology, vertex count, and correspondence, so we test diversity empirically. Joint training also needs scale normalization by a training-set statistic ( Lam et al., 2023 ) or an instance-level observable ( Kim et al., 2022 ; Passalis et al., 2020 ; Salinas et al., 2020 ; Yin et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2022 ; McCabe et al., 2024 ; Zuo et al., 2025 ) . Villar et al. (2023) write shared forms as a gauge length times a dimensionless function ( Buckingham, 1914 ) , and dimensionless groups can be discovered from data ( Bakarji et al., 2022 ; Xie et al., 2022 ) . We apply this to the residual after harmonic extension, in the spirit of residual physics ( Zeng et al., 2020 ) , and recover the unit from observed displacement dispersion plus a dimensionless correction (§ 3.3 , § 5.3 ). Our backbone follows graph-network simulators ( Sanchez-Gonzalez et al., 2020 ) , whose multiscale ( Fortunato et al., 2022 ; Cao et al., 2023 ) and attention-augmented variants ( Janny et al., 2023 ; Hao et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) carry information between distant observed vertices. Unlike flow matching on manifolds ( Chen & Lipman, 2024 ) , latent-point mesh diffusion ( Lyu et al., 2023 ) , or native 4D generation ( Li et al., 2025 ) , we sample a dimensionless residual field in Euclidean space with the standard flow-matching objective.

blocks.en: In two settings the observation comes from a signal that exists independently of the model: a robot’s proprioception, and a point tracker’s output. In Isaac Lab ( Mittal et al., 2025 ) , a Franka arm grips and lifts a soft bar (Figure 3 ). We represent the arm, base, and payload as a unified 5,525-point set without faces, connected solely by a 12-nearest-neighbor spatial graph without contact constraints. Observations comprise eight robot proprioceptive points (four on the gripper, four on the base) and zero on the payload. Figure 3 shows five independent completions, propagating boundary signals across bodies without kinematic models. On a DAVIS ( Perazzi et al., 2016 ) sequence, 12 consistent vertex tracks derived from CoTracker3 ( Karaev et al., 2025 ) across frames 4–39 serve as sparse inputs on the target. These tracker outputs, rather than exact displacements, are completed across a mesh reconstructed from one frame by TripoSR ( Tochilkin et al., 2024 ) . Figure 4 b visualizes 120 completed vertices on the animal’s far side, facing away from the reference camera and disjoint from the observed set (Appendix D ).

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Cepheid completes dense motion across geometry families without skeletons, registration, or cross-mesh correspondence. Discrete harmonic extension is our parameter-free base and control; seven of twelve single-family transfers fail to beat it. Decoupling residual structure from scale, we estimate amplitude without target motion alongside a dimensionless flow-matching prior; on unseen cloth, completion error is within 1–8% of a target-informed oracle. One unified model beats harmonic extension on all five families (15.6% lower error on cloth, 10.1% on legged bodies) and applies without retraining to point-tracked animal video and a robot grasping a soft body.
blocks.zh: 塞菲德完成跨越几何家族的密集运动,没有骨架,注册,或交叉梅斯通信. 分明的口琴扩展是我们无参数的基础和控制;在12个单家调用中,有7个未能战胜. 将剩余结构与尺度脱钩,我们估计振幅不带目标运动,与前作的无尺寸相匹配;在隐形布上,完成误差在目标知情的甲骨文的一至八分以内。 一个统一的模型在所有五个家庭(布上15.6%的误差,腿上10.1%的误差)上都击败了口琴扩展,并且在不进行再培训的情况下适用于有指向的动物视频和一个机器人抓住了软体.

In comparison, the unified model processes 4.0 4.0 million samples from DT4D, 2.4 2.4 million from AMASS, and 1.6 1.6 million from Franka ( 2 – 5 × 2\text{--}5\times fewer exposures per individual source).

blocks.en: B.4 Emission ratios

blocks.en: What the unified model exhibits that the specialists do not is the ability to output a residual correction of approximately the required scale across diverse target geometries. We measure this property using the emission ratio, defined as the mean per-vertex ℓ 2 \ell_{2} length of the predicted physical correction s ^ ​ R ¯ θ \hat{s}\bar{R}_{\theta} divided by that of the unobserved residual left by the base field F − H F-H , over the evaluated vertices and pooled across conditions.

blocks.en: Message passing resolves local deformation shared across neighboring vertices, whereas non-local attention relates distant surface regions lacking short graph paths. As reported in Table 12 , comparing MGN-T against a matched-budget message-passing control yields relative error reductions of 7.5% at 0.5% observation and between 2.0% and 3.3% from 2% through 50% density. Pooled over the five densities, MGN-T achieves a 4.9% error reduction and is lower on all seven held-out identities.

blocks.en: Because performance gains are concentrated where unobserved vertices lie multiple hops away from observations, attention is primarily advantageous under sparse coverage. blocks.en: F.1 Why the metric pools rather than averages
blocks.zh: F.1 联合国 为什么是公积而不是平均值

blocks.en: The pooled relative error (Equation 6 ) aggregates condition-specific errors and motion displacements across all evaluation instances before taking their quotient. An arithmetic mean of per-condition relative errors normalizes by each condition’s own motion magnitude, allowing instances with near-zero ground-truth motion to disproportionately dominate the summary statistic. In contrast, pooled aggregation weights each condition strictly in proportion to its physical motion magnitude.
blocks.zh: 集合相对错误(方程式6)汇总了所有评价情况下的特定条件错误和运动移位,然后取出其商号。 有条件的相对误差的算术平均值会因每个条件本身的运动量而正常化,从而使得近乎零的地面真实运动的情况在简要统计中占据了不成比例的地位。 相形之下,集合权重严格按照每个条件的物理运动体积的比例进行。

blocks.en: F.2 The normalization used in Table 2
blocks.zh: F.2 联合国 表2采用的正常化

blocks.en: Table 2 reports entries divided by a single constant per column, defined as the mean ground-truth displacement across that column’s evaluation conditions. Because numerator and denominator are averaged over identical evaluation instances, the resulting quotient matches the pooled relative error exactly, ensuring that any normalized cell remains directly invertible back to physical units.
blocks.zh: 表2按每栏一个常数除以各栏评价条件的地面真相平均转移。 由于数字和分母在相同的评价实例中是平均值,结果的商数与集合相对误差完全吻合,确保任何正态的单元格仍然直接回向物理单位.

blocks.en: F.3 The base fixed point
blocks.zh: F.3 联合国 基准固定点

blocks.en: Because the base is closed-form and model-independent, it serves as the fixed point every row is anchored to. It is the first row of Table 1 , where it reads 0.6255 / 0.3533 / 0.2257 / 0.1598 / 0.0754; averaged over the same conditions in mAU, it gives 53.256 / 30.084 / 19.216 / 13.611 / 6.423. We verified it independently against our own run’s base column, DOMA’s aggregation, and NSDP’s choice of weighting. Recomputing the harmonic row from NSDP’s evaluation using motion-weighted pooling reproduces this exact fixed point.
blocks.zh: 由于地基是封闭式和模型独立的,它充当了每行锚地的固定点. 它是表1的第一行,它读作:0.6255/0.3533/0.2257/0.1598/0.0754;平均在mAU的相同条件下,它给出了53.256/ 30.084/ 19.216/ 13.611/ 6.423. 我们根据本赛季的基干栏、DOMA的汇总和NSDP的权重选择, 独立核实了它。 使用运动加权集合来对口琴行进行评估,

blocks.en: F.4 The amplitude protocol
blocks.zh: F.4 联合国 振幅协议

blocks.en: Every cell in Table 2 uses the predicted amplitude, read from parameters stored in the checkpoint rather than from any external configuration, and all four models carry the single rule fitted on DT4D, AMASS, and Franka. The rule has access to the three source columns and to neither held-out family. A table fitted on the target serves strictly as a target-informed reference and is never quoted as a deployable result.
blocks.zh: 表2中的每个单元格都使用预测振幅,从检查站所储存的参数读取,而不是从任何外部配置来读取,所有四个模型都携带了安装在DT4D,AMASS,和Franka上的单一规则. 该规则可进入三个来源栏目,也不得进入被扣留的家庭。 在目标上安装的表格严格地作为目标知情的参考,从未作为可部署的结果引用。

blocks.en: A deployed arm observes the same few points every frame, which is not how any of our training masks are drawn. We fine-tune the unified checkpoint for 10k steps at lr = 10 − 4 \mathrm{lr}=10^{-4} on this source, drawing each training sample’s observed subset and its size once, from a seeded draw over sizes from 1 to all vertices, mostly from the gripper and in about 7% of samples across the arm, so the model sees many placements rather than the one it is evaluated on. We evaluate on held-out episodes at the marker count a three-marker rig would carry, with the observations drawn from the gripper vertices by farthest-point selection.
blocks.zh: 一个部署的臂部观察着每个相框的同样点数,我们的任何训练口罩都不是这样抽取的. 我们在这个来源上微调10k步的统一检查点, 我们评估在标记计数处的被搁置事件 一个三标记钻机将携带, 从抓取顶点的观察 取出最远的点。

blocks.en: As reported in Table 15 , the fine-tuned prior more than halves the error, from 0.86 × 0.86\times the base to 0.37 × 0.37\times it. Because the architecture and amplitude recovery are unchanged from the zero-shot row, the gain is in the weights and not in the inference procedure.
blocks.zh: 如表15所报告,以前经过微调的误差已减半以上,从0.86×0.86正时到0.37×0.37正时。 由于结构和振幅恢复与"零射行"没有变化,所以增益在于权重而非推论程序.
